I just voted to pass legislation to provide greater transparency and accountability in our elections and make it easier to exercise your freedom to vote. We must put the power of our democracy back in the hands of the people. I urge the Senate to act. 1/2
https://t.co/fGFxEylGb2

Hoping for a quick recovery and thankful your symptoms have been mild, @SenatorShaheen. 
 
Reminder to all Granite Staters to protect yourself and others by getting vaccinated and boosted if you haven't already – visit https://t.co/8GfW1HnQNP for more information.

Wastewater infrastructure is vital to communities across New Hampshire. Today I toured Hampton's wastewater treatment facility with state and town officials and discussed the importance of water infrastructure and the critical federal investments being made throughout the state. https://t.co/LySXTdM3P8

This week, I joined @RepJoeWilson in a bipartisan call on @CMSGov to investigate the impact of staffing shortages and supply chain disruptions on dialysis treatment. It's vital we work to ensure that no patient faces avoidable disruptions to their care.

➡️https://t.co/26het0wTtF https://t.co/zwVpfre0Jj

No New Hampshire family has been left untouched by the opioid crisis. And deaths are rising. We must do all we can, including passing legislation I introduced to get dangerous drugs like fentanyl out of our communities and hold traffickers accountable. 

https://t.co/2VXFFYpfqt

As overdoses rise, we need to see collaboration at all levels to take on this crisis and save lives. I remain committed to securing funds for prevention, enforcement, and treatment for individuals experiencing substance use disorder and their families.

https://t.co/fnaZ4NGfzi

Today I tested positive for COVID-19 after noticing mild symptoms. I will be following CDC guidance while continuing my duties remotely. Our offices will remain open next week for constituents. 

Please get vaccinated and boosted if eligible and take precautions to stay safe.

Today I had the chance to tour Peirce Island Wastewater Treatment Plant with @DeaglanM & Senator Rebecca Perkins Kwoka. It’s critical we invest in our water infrastructure, and I’ll keep fighting to support projects that improve the quality of life for all Granite Staters. https://t.co/CPRFMqDAgJ

New Hampshire is receiving major upgrades to our water infrastructure thanks to federal legislation I fought to pass in Congress.

These improvements include:
- Replacing lead pipes
- Upgrading stormwater systems
- New wastewater treatment technology

https://t.co/fYOjFhrHp7

Today @EPA took an essential step forward for public health by proposing a national standard to limit PFAS in drinking water.

I’ll keep working to upgrade water infrastructure, hold polluters accountable, and set limits on industrial discharges of PFAS.

https://t.co/CsKwVDBBVe

Having access to quality, balanced meals at school is a game changer for students. Today I met with administrators and nutrition staff from several #NH01 districts to learn more about their work and how Congress can provide support. 

And I pitched in to help serve up some lunch! https://t.co/Tw7b2y86ae

Got to the Vic Geary Senior Center in Plaistow just in time to help serve lunch with Rockingham Nutrition and Meals on Wheels. I was glad to be able to meet with staff and volunteers and hear directly from the folks who rely on Meals on Wheels and other vital community programs. https://t.co/0KdlHI7gCK

October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth.

Early detection of breast cancer through routine screening can mean less extensive treatment, more treatment options, & better outcomes. Don’t forget to ask your health care provider about regular screenings, & what’s recommended for you.

This week the House passed legislation that will help address substance use disorder, from expanding prevention and treatment programs to supporting first responders.

It also included my critical provision to crack down on the illegal use of xylazine.

➡️https://t.co/bCpm6iC0iK https://t.co/FyhwyyS92m

I met with leaders from @WaypointNH about their critical work to help those in need and end youth homelessness.

We must continue working to ensure everyone has access to safe, secure shelter, health care, and a good night’s sleep before they wake up and go to work or school. https://t.co/0aRNaW7wKb

It should never be up to politicians to decide how or when families have kids. Yet House Republicans sent a letter to VA calling IVF treatment for veterans “morally dubious.”

Access to IVF treatment should be included in the health benefits our service members have earned. https://t.co/0AHOCYRj6R

Honored to help cut the ribbon at the new Manchester VA Veteran Wellness Center! 

There is no more sacred promise we make than to care for those who have served our country. This new facility will ensure that Granite State veterans get the resources and support they have earned. https://t.co/WQ8RerQvFd

We owe a debt to our veterans that we can never fully repay.

The new Manchester VA Veteran Wellness Center is an important step forward to ensure that NH veterans get the resources and support they’re owed, and I was honored to join the ribbon cutting ceremony this week. https://t.co/LrddC03vm8

#NationalFentanylAwarenessDay is a reminder of the dangers of fentanyl and the work still needed to tackle this pressing public health crisis.

We must continue to take action to save lives, hold traffickers accountable, and provide treatment and support to those in need.

Access to substance use disorder and mental health treatment is critical as we continue working to combat the addiction epidemic and help those in need.

This extension will save lives and improve outcomes by strengthening access and care coordination.

➡️ https://t.co/MGgHST2eqq https://t.co/uNcMzfn8V4

A comprehensive approach to confronting the addiction epidemic must include prevention efforts, recovery services, and focus on young people.

This bill brings evidence-informed treatment to educate students on substance misuse & help those in recovery.

➡️https://t.co/JWLIfeSDJB https://t.co/nXa4NiSceL

October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth.

Early detection of breast cancer through routine screening can mean less extensive treatment, more treatment options, and better outcomes. Make sure to talk to your health care provider to know what’s best for you. https://t.co/aQwT9wD48O

This legislative package helps address key veterans issues, including strengthening home- and community-based care, fighting veteran homelessness, and bolstering mental health and substance use disorder treatment.

I urge the Senate to pass it.

➡️https://t.co/ibkdOF3PRL https://t.co/5MYWAxkv67

To celebrate Community Champions Week, I volunteered with Meals on Wheels.

Their work is more than delivering meals. Their deliveries provide wellness checks, social interaction, and much more.

I won't stop working to return federal dollars to our communities to help those in need.

The Trump administration is cutting $80 million for New Hampshire health services, from mental health to substance use disorder treatment.

This is funding that New Hampshire was counting on, and losing these dollars will harm public health and safety.

https://t.co/q0kfydcZK9
